Nutrition Tips
	1.	 Milk and yogurt are good sources of calcium and protein.
	2.	 The higher the fat content of milk and yogurt, the more 
saturated fat and cholesterol it has.
	3.	 Children over the age of 2 and adults should choose lower-
fat varieties such as skim, 1%, or 2% milks or yogurts.
Selection Tips
	1.	 1 cup equals 8 fluid oz or 1⁄2 pint.
	2.	 If you choose 2%, or whole-milk foods, be aware of the 
extra fat.
